title: Night-time Childcare Centres for Low-income Parents who Work Night Shifts
what_it_is: Night-time Childcare Centres for Low-income Parents who Work Night Shifts

sections.label: Childcare centres extended hours
sections.summary: Childcare centres may extend services beyond standard hours based on demand and resources, with around 50 centres operating beyond 7.00 pm on weekdays.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Childcare centres have the discretion to extend their services beyond standard operating hours, taking into consideration demand and resources.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Currently, around 50 childcare centres operate beyond 7.00 pm on weekdays.

sections.label: Night-time childcare need assessment
sections.summary: The need and demand for night-time childcare will be assessed, particularly in areas where low-income families reside, as described in the ComLink rollout pilot.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: However, some families may face difficulties in making alternate caregiving arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will assess the need and demand for night-time childcare and the possibility of offering such programmes, particularly in areas where low-income families reside.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Member may also have heard us describe in the course of announcing the rollout of ComLink in the four areas where rental flats are, as a pilot.

sections.label: Night caregiving pilot programmes
sections.summary: Voluntary welfare organisations run pilot programmes providing night caregiving support, and their experience will be studied further.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, I am just wondering whether we can help provide the night-time childcare in cases like these.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There are voluntary welfare organisations that are running programmes as pilots to provide night caregiving support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will look at their experience and study this further.
